decisions.reason: The single-tube air fin cooler is core to the firm's announced heat exchanger direction and was publicly launched only a year ago, so sunk engineering investment and commitment favor persistence.
As part of the publicly promoted single-tube condenser line, any weak early results can still be attributed to normal ramp-up in long industrial sales cycles.
Although it overlaps with Product B and could be consolidated, management's investment in the variant and its fit with the single-tube strategy make keeping it the more likely choice.
Tube liners for corroded exchangers build on the firm's repair expertise and serve an aftermarket that grows slowly, so the firm is likely to persist.
Customized industrial air coolers are close to the established business and require little dedicated investment to keep offering, so dropping them is unlikely.
Tube end repair inserts complement the liner offering in the visible repair portfolio, and slow early uptake can be explained as temporary market adoption.
